mechanism.foreground_owner: git-watch --action session --command <explicit argv>; the command must wait for the real host session lifetime.
mechanism.windows: The owner retains the non-inheritable Job handle and EOF write end; observer members receive read-end authority, while the user host receives neither observer authority nor observer Job membership.
mechanism.posix: Owner EOF revokes joined members in their inherited private session/process group; intentionally detached descendants remain outside the stated guarantee.
mechanism.supervisor_recovery: The still-active foreground owner can replace a supervisor after native supervisor guard acquisition, cooperate in old-worker revocation, and wait for native ownership release; no signal based on a recorded bare PID.
mechanism.session_end: Normal host end closes containment; observer-owned guards must release before normal ended metadata is acknowledged. Hard owner exit leaves metadata for finite no-spawn reconciliation after native guard proof.
mechanism.unsupported_host: No permanent adapter or global host configuration is injected. An editor/launcher without a reliable foreground wait/close signal receives finite lifecycle/checkpoint behavior and no detached automatic observer.
mechanism.explicit_tick: Finite explicitly requested synchronous tick remains available without requiring a foreground observer session.
unverified_adapter_claims: No claim that arbitrary editors are adapted.
